requiredChecks.requirement: fixture, reset, and eligibility assets exist at the declared repo-relative locations and each parses as one JSON object
all three assets match origin, batchId, candidateId, and their required schemaVersion
SHA-256 of fixtureRef bytes exactly equals fixtureSha256
SHA-256 of resetRef bytes exactly equals resetSha256
fixture executionTrack is simulator, syntheticOnly is true, and no live target or credential is configured
fixture variants contain exactly normal, failure, and recovery and recovery includes deterministic failure injection
reset deterministic is true and resetState is deeply equal to fixture initialState
all resetSteps completed in order and every postcondition passed before variant selection
each consequential action names a non-null approval-token class and the fixture blocks unknown, missing, expired, or mismatched tokens
the token exists and exactly matches candidate, action, shipment, selected option, disclosures, commitment, and current authoritative version
canonicalFinalState and safeHandoff each declare an authoritative source, required fields, and a completion predicate
the simulator can return every required field for canonicalFinalState or every required field for safeHandoff
exactly one terminal branch satisfies all required fields and its predicate; submission response alone and partial readback never pass

ineligibleWhen: any required asset is absent, unparsable, misidentified, or uses the wrong schema
either declared SHA-256 differs from current referenced bytes
reset is skipped, nondeterministic, out of order, or not deeply equal to fixture initialState
the selected variant is missing or outside the exact normal, failure, recovery set
a live target, credential, non-synthetic entity, or non-simulator execution track is present
a consequential action lacks a matching approval token at action time
a new option, cost, data field, condition, commitment, or authoritative version is not covered by the token
authoritative readback is unavailable and the complete safe-handoff branch cannot be produced
only a partial terminal state or a submission response is available
any check result is false, unknown, missing, stale, or not evaluated

eligibleResult.actionGate: re-evaluate approval-token-valid-for-action before every consequential action
eligibleResult.terminalGate: re-evaluate readback and terminal-state checks before any completion claim
